name: costas_array_n8__v6_nh
prompt:
Find a Costas array of order 8: place 8 marks on an 8x8 grid, one per row and one per column, such that all 8*(7)/2 displacement vectors (dr, dc) between pairs of marks (with dc > 0) are pairwise distinct.

Return x as a list of 8 integers in 0..7, where x[c] is the row of the mark in column c (permutation), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such array exists.
